title: Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs in Funding Talks for at Least $40 Billion Value
source_used: Bloomberg text as carried by Yahoo Finance UK (opens with '(Bloomberg) --'). Bloomberg itself blocked (403, bot check).
key_facts: Isomorphic Labs is a London-based AI drug discovery startup spun out of Google DeepMind; it was formed in 2021 to commercialise AlphaFold.
It is in early talks to raise new funds at a valuation of at least $40 billion, according to people familiar; the round could value it as high as $50 billion.
The financing has not closed and details could change; Isomorphic did not respond to a request for comment.
Five months ago Isomorphic raised $2.1 billion in a Series B round; Alphabet provided a large part of it, per Demis Hassabis, chief executive of Isomorphic Labs.
Isomorphic has partnerships with Eli Lilly and Novartis and plans to focus on cancer and immune disorders.
The article says few AI drug developers have reached clinical trials and none has brought a medicine to market.
quote_evidence: Isomorphic Labs, an AI-powered drug discovery startup spun out of Alphabet Inc.'s Google DeepMind, is in early talks to raise new funds at a valuation of at least $40 billion, according to people familiar with the effort.
The financing hasn't closed and details could change, the people said.
Only five months ago, Isomorphic Labs raised $2.1 billion in its series B funding effort, Bloomberg News reported.
why_it_matters_hint: Investor appetite for AI-led drug discovery; the talks are early and the valuation comes from people familiar.
